headline: Approved MSBA delegate, staff nominations, extra-duty assignments, donations, and two revised policies by 6-0 votes.
summary: The committee approved the 26-27 MSBA local delegate and alternate, an assistant superintendent nomination, several teacher nominations, and multiple extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 school year. It also approved a list of donations to several schools and approved the second reading of two revised policies. All votes were 6-0.
decisions: Approved the 26-27 MSBA local delegate, Sara Luciano, 6-0.
Approved the 26-27 MSBA alternate, Katie Brydon, 6-0.
Approved the administrator nomination of Paul Butler as Assistant Superintendent, Central Office, 6-0.
Approved teacher nominations for the 2026-2027 school year with one-year probationary contracts, 6-0.
Approved extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 school year, 6-0.
Approved the donations shared by Committee Member Shelly Okere, 6-0.
Approved the second reading of Revised Policy IHBAC and Revised Policy JLF, 6-0.
